name: Unnamed
source:
As protagonist in the story, the story proceeds from the first person point of view of the character.
In fact, he is a middle school student, but for some reason, he enters the body of a male student who is about to enter a high school in the future, loses his memory, and lives without going back, and meets a ghost girl only in his eyes ahead of summer vacation.
